wizard.title: New academic year
wizard.intro: Move the institute into the next {year} step by step. Nothing is switched by itself, and no dues move.
wizard.yearHint: Create it from the current one (its sections are copied), or pick one you made.
wizard.feesHint: Copy this year's fee setup into the new one. Each copy can be run again: what is already there is kept.
wizard.copyConcessionsHint: Off by default: only concessions still running at the year's end, for students already enrolled in the new year.
wizard.outsideYear: {n, plural, one {{count} term has a date} other {{count} terms have dates}} outside the new year: check them in fee setup.
wizard.teachersHint: By class and {section} name. Staff who left and deactivated subjects are skipped.
wizard.teachersCopied: Copied {sections} {section} teachers and {subjects} subject teachers; skipped {skipped}.
wizard.promoteHint: Start a run for each class: who is promoted, who repeats and who leaves. Defaults come from the published annual results.
wizard.noRuns: No class of the year before has students.
wizard.rollsHint: Per class of the new year, after its runs are applied: promoted students first, then repeaters, then new admits. Rolls already set are kept.
wizard.rollsNone: No one in this {classLevel} of the new year is waiting for a roll.
wizard.rollsWithoutSection: {count} without a {section}: give them one first.
wizard.switchHint: Check what is not finished. Students not enrolled in the new year leave the due list and attendance after the switch.
wizard.switchNotCarriedOver: {n, plural, one {{count} student} other {{count} students}} of last year not in the new year
wizard.switchWithoutRoll: {n, plural, one {{count} student} other {{count} students}} without a roll
wizard.switchUnderstand: I understand what is not finished
wizard.rollsPendingRuns: Runs into this class are not applied yet ({names}: {count} students). Numbered now, the students they bring come after everyone numbered.
wizard.switchWithoutSection: {n, plural, one {{count} student} other {{count} students}} in the new year without a {section}

run.title: {classLevel}: {from} → {to}
run.noMeritExam: No published annual results: everyone is promoted, without a result.
run.refreshed: The list is up to date
run.applyHint: Enrols everyone promoted or repeating in the new year (without a roll) and marks those leaving, in the background. It can be resumed if it stops, and never enrols anyone twice. Those leaving leave now.

errors.RUN_APPLYING: This run is being applied. Wait for it to finish.
errors.RUN_EXISTS: This class already has a run into that year.
errors.PREVIEW_CHANGED: Something changed meanwhile. Check again, then apply.
errors.SECTION_FULL: A {section} would be over capacity. Raise its capacity or move some students.
errors.TARGET_INVALID: Some rows have a target that does not fit (marked).
errors.MERIT_NEEDS_EXAMS: Merit order needs published exam results.
errors.MERIT_EXAM_INVALID: That exam is not published for this class.
errors.ROLL_TAKEN: That roll is already taken in the {section}.
errors.YEAR_ORDER: The new year must start after this one.
errors.ACTOR_NOT_ADMIN: the admin who started it is no longer an admin
errors.ERROR: an error; resume to try again
errors.TIMEOUT: it took too long; resume to try again
errors.RUNS_PENDING: Runs into this class are not applied yet. Apply them first, or number anyway.
errors.RUN_HAS_APPLIED: Some rows are applied: the run stays.

run.deleteBody: Nothing of it is applied. The list of decisions goes; you can start the class again.
